description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Maximum Retail Price for Eggs
categorisation: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003 (Amended). It establishes maximum retail prices for specific consumer goods (eggs) and imposes compliance requirements on manufacturers, producers, suppliers, distributors, and traders. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, statutory instruments, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
